patterns.description: Physical vertical scroll input translates a story or gallery horizontally while the viewport remains pinned in place.
patterns.narrative_purpose: Communicates lateral chapter progression, evolution, portfolios, or chronological sequence without changing overall document flow.
avoid_when: Text blocks are heavy and dense
patterns.primary_technique: GSAP ScrollTrigger pin + scrub horizontal translation
patterns.reduced_motion_strategy: Convert to natural unpinned vertical card sequence with instant visibility

patterns.description: Document flows vertically, smoothly pivots into a dedicated horizontal world, completes an expansive chapter, and exits cleanly back into vertical document flow.
patterns.narrative_purpose: Signals departure from normal reading into an immersive product world or manufacturing atelier, reinforcing a sense of entry and exit.
avoid_when: Short pages with fewer than 3 major sections
patterns.primary_technique: GSAP ScrollTrigger pin container with entrance/exit transitions
patterns.reduced_motion_strategy: Unpinned vertical sections with standard section spacing

patterns.description: One half of the screen remains anchored (persistent visual object, architectural model, or chapter index) while the other half scrolls narrative content.
patterns.narrative_purpose: Provides a persistent visual anchor or context while complex modular evidence or technical specifications unfold alongside.
best_for: Case studies with fixed hero imagery
avoid_when: Screens with equal priority multi-column data
patterns.primary_technique: CSS position: sticky or GSAP ScrollTrigger pin
patterns.reduced_motion_strategy: Standard stacked layout with static sticky anchors

patterns.description: Scroll progressively translates, scales, and locks individual components, layers, or structural parts together into a completed system.
patterns.narrative_purpose: Communicates craftsmanship, precision engineering, internal architecture, and modular integrity by showing how parts form the whole.
avoid_when: Pure software or abstract services without physical/modular components
patterns.primary_technique: GSAP Timeline pinned scrub with CSS transforms (x, y, scale, autoAlpha)
patterns.reduced_motion_strategy: Display fully assembled state with static callout breakdown list
content_requirements: Isolated layer assets or transparent component PNG/SVGs

patterns.description: Scroll moves a virtual 3D camera along a defined trajectory (dolly, orbit, crane, or room traversal) through a spatial scene.
patterns.narrative_purpose: Transports the visitor through physical scale, spatial depth, or interior environments impossible to capture in flat layouts.
avoid_when: When 2D imagery communicates the product faster and sharper
patterns.primary_technique: Three.js / WebGL camera coordinate interpolation mapped to ScrollTrigger
patterns.reduced_motion_strategy: Static high-resolution rendered keyframes with zero camera motion

patterns.description: Consecutive full-width section cards or chapter decks scroll upward, stick at top of viewport, and stack or reveal subsequent cards beneath them.
patterns.narrative_purpose: Creates a tangible sense of progression across distinct pillars, principles, or pillars of strategy without breaking vertical flow.
patterns.primary_technique: CSS position: sticky + top offsets or GSAP ScrollTrigger stack scrub
patterns.reduced_motion_strategy: Normal vertical scroll with zero scale transforms
content_requirements: 3-5 cards with uniform aspect ratio and clear title hierarchy

patterns.description: A thumbnail or card image scales up with scroll until it fills 100% of the viewport and seamlessly reveals the next section's interior environment.
patterns.narrative_purpose: Creates cinematic continuity between high-level overview and deep environmental immersion.
patterns.primary_technique: GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub scaling image container from inset to fixed viewport
patterns.reduced_motion_strategy: Instant cross-fade or standard block layout

patterns.description: Scroll scrubs vector paths, typographic letterforms, or geometric wireframes from one meaningful state or silhouette into another.
patterns.narrative_purpose: Symbolizes transition, alchemy, precision refinement, or adaptive functionality.
avoid_when: Gratuitous decorative shape twisting without brand meaning
patterns.primary_technique: GSAP MorphSVG / SVG path interpolation scrubbed via ScrollTrigger
patterns.reduced_motion_strategy: Display final state statically with zero path morphing

patterns.description: The viewport acts as an aperture or architectural corridor where layered foreground masks, framing portals, and midground planes part as scroll advances.
patterns.narrative_purpose: Evokes exclusivity, uncovering hidden mastery, or passing through architectural thresholds.
patterns.primary_technique: CSS clip-path / mask-image animation mapped to GSAP ScrollTrigger
optional_techniques: Differential parallax depth on foreground portals
patterns.reduced_motion_strategy: Unmasked static layout with clean dividers

patterns.description: Scroll moves the perspective through multi-layered 2.5D or 3D planes using scale, blur, and opacity changes rather than standard vertical translation.
patterns.narrative_purpose: Creates an expansive dimensional journey, drawing the user inward through scale layers.
patterns.primary_technique: CSS 3D perspective + GSAP transform (translateZ, scale, filter: blur)
optional_techniques: Multi-layer Canvas 2D or Three.js depth buffer
patterns.reduced_motion_strategy: Sequential vertical sections with static scale and no blur
content_requirements: Clear focal point at each depth stop

patterns.description: Scroll translates the canvas along an intentional diagonal, curved, or isometric vector across an expansive conceptual map or blueprint.
patterns.narrative_purpose: Breaks rectilinear grid constraints to express continuous flow, architectural plans, or systemic navigation.
patterns.primary_technique: GSAP coordinate mapping translating an oversized canvas on X and Y axes simultaneously
patterns.reduced_motion_strategy: Standard linear vertical stack with static map snapshots
content_requirements: High-res isometric canvas or vector floorplan

patterns.description: A calibrated temporal axis or milestone rail remains pinned while historical events, milestones, or iterations scrub through the viewport.
patterns.narrative_purpose: Provides grounded temporal context, demonstrating heritage, evolution, or forward roadmap velocity.
patterns.primary_technique: GSAP ScrollTrigger pinned track with milestone progress bar and active state highlights
patterns.reduced_motion_strategy: Static vertical timeline with all entries expanded
content_requirements: Chronological date-tagged milestone items with verified copy

patterns.description: Scroll seamlessly navigates from macro object view into granular microscopic detail (e.g. building -> facade -> material weave).
patterns.narrative_purpose: Proves relentless obsession with detail, material quality, and micro-engineering.
avoid_when: Digital services with no tangible material texture
patterns.primary_technique: GSAP scale + clip-rect zoom scrub on multi-resolution asset stacks
patterns.reduced_motion_strategy: Side-by-side macro and micro static comparison images
content_requirements: Macro and micro high-fidelity paired photography

patterns.description: A signature physical aperture, viewfinder, architectural window, or device bezel remains fixed in the viewport while worlds scroll behind or inside it.
patterns.narrative_purpose: Frames the story through the brand's own lens, instrument, or iconic product silhouette.
avoid_when: Generic mockups with no brand meaning
patterns.primary_technique: Fixed overlay container with overflow:hidden and scrubbed background layers
patterns.reduced_motion_strategy: Static frame with single representative hero scene

patterns.description: Scroll acts as a continuous numerical input scrubbing an interactive state machine (e.g., biometric strain -> recovery, aerodynamic drag -> lift).
patterns.narrative_purpose: Transforms abstract operational data into a dynamic, visceral cause-and-effect narrative.
avoid_when: When state inputs have no clear physical or mathematical meaning
patterns.primary_technique: Rive State Machine numeric input or GSAP scrubbed HUD telemetry
optional_techniques: Dynamic color gradient shift based on state threshold
patterns.reduced_motion_strategy: Static step-by-step state cards with pre-rendered gauges
content_requirements: Interactive Rive artboard or SVG HUD

patterns.description: Narrative typography and cards slide behind and between silhouetted foreground environmental elements at differential speeds.
patterns.narrative_purpose: Establishes rich physical depth, atmosphere, and cinematic tangibility without WebGL.
avoid_when: Small screens where foreground elements obscure text readability
patterns.primary_technique: Multi-layer CSS z-index stack with GSAP yPercent parallax offsets
optional_techniques: Subtle depth of field blur on extreme foreground element
patterns.reduced_motion_strategy: Remove parallax offsets; flatten to static layered stack
content_requirements: Transparent silhouetted foreground asset (e.g. steel beam, mountain contour, timber pillar)

patterns.description: Projects and artifacts exist across a large multi-directional visual plane, navigating via smooth momentum pan or controlled scroll triggers.
patterns.narrative_purpose: Provides a curator's gallery experience, encouraging nonlinear exploration and serendipitous discovery.
avoid_when: Audience with strict task-focused lookup needs
patterns.primary_technique: Infinite/bounded 2D canvas translation with accessible semantic DOM links

patterns.description: Scroll travels directly into a negative space aperture (e.g. inside a typography letter, camera lens, or doorway) to reveal the next conceptual universe.
patterns.narrative_purpose: Creates a dramatic conceptual rupture or leap into the core essence of a brand or revelation.
avoid_when: Frequent repetition across a single site (use exactly once per site)
patterns.primary_technique: GSAP scale transform (up to 20x) with clip-path mask to transparent viewport
patterns.reduced_motion_strategy: Instant section cut with zero zoom expansion
content_requirements: Vector aperture graphic or clean mask
